offers.description: Return a privacy-minimized official parcel context record, including released land-use, physical-property, zoning, and assessor attributes for jurisdictions with a supported parcel source.

description: Paid $0.10 USD. Return privacy-minimized official parcel and land-use attributes where a supported parcel source is released. Use this for parcel facts; use check_zoning_context for released zoning context or build_property_intelligence_pack for cross-source context. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

inputSchema.description: Resolve one property or place before running the requested LocalProof operation.

address.description: Street address or place to research. Include locality information when available.

city.description: Optional city used to disambiguate the address and route it to a supported LocalProof jurisdiction.

state.description: Optional state name or abbreviation. Current released jurisdictions are in California; use CA or California.

unit.description: Optional unit, suite, or apartment identifier when it is relevant to property identity.

name: localproof.check_parcel_context
title: Check Parcel Context
